common_name: Bodacious Sweet Corn (Early Yellow Supersweet Hybrid)

planting.note: Direct sow after last frost when soil reaches 60°F; plant in blocks of at least four rows and isolate from other corn types, since Bodacious carries the supersweet (sh2) gene and cross-pollination with standard corn produces starchy, tough kernels.

directions: Plant in full sun in well-drained, fertile soil in blocks for good pollination, keeping it isolated from other corn types to protect its supersweet genetics. Bodacious is a widely planted early yellow supersweet hybrid known for large, well-filled ears, dependable vigorous performance across a range of conditions, and excellent sweetness that holds up well for several days after harvest thanks to its sh2 supersweet trait. Its relatively early maturity makes it a good choice for a first planting of the season or for shorter growing windows, and it has long been a standard variety in home garden and market trials. Harvest once silks brown and kernels are plump and milky when tested, and refrigerate promptly to preserve peak sweetness.
